intro.text: A river in southern Alethkar that runs through the Eastern Crownlands and into Mevan Bay.

description.text: It is among the steadiest rivers on Roshar, never running dry even in the Midpeace, and it lies on a good caravan route.
Six or seven villages, one of them a town of some note, sit along its southern fork.

items.text: Gavilar and Dalinar Kholin were exploring one of the Deathbend's tributaries when they came upon the Parshendi.
Dalinar Kholin and Elhokar granted Kaladin, now a Shardbearer ranked in the fourth dahn, a stretch of land along the southern fork. It had passed back to the crown when its local brightlord died.
